reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Quiet Lens logo rollout
reason: The changed journey is seeing one upright Quiet Lens mark at launch, in navigation, and in browser, install, and packaged app icons. The 25 collected SideNav component cases cover the shared navigation component. Ten catalogued Quiet Lens browser cases cover launch, navigation reveal and panel width, theme selection, SVG and raster asset loading, and desktop/mobile geometry in permanent Chromium and WebKit profiles. A production build and generated-icon inspection cover bundle and package assets.
exclusions: No Core database, Python, Rust behavior, provider, harness, or workspace state changed, so those test layers and unrelated UI journeys are excluded. Browser tests use mocked API responses; production LAN asset loading is checked separately. Physical-device behavior and installed desktop packaging remain unverified. Full suites are excluded.
